articles.summary: In short: No benchmark isolates AR platform type as the driver of close speed. Automation and integration reduce close time—but those gains depend on implementation quality and whether the tool fits your billing model. For companies with simpler invoicing and complex consolidation, ERP-integrated AR usually wins because fewer records move between disconnected systems.
